description: AAASM-5345: a full-width 16-digit run whose final check digit is altered fails Luhn and must stay clean. Full-width digits are ordinary content in CJK text — order numbers, quantities, dates — so widening what reaches the checksum must not widen what passes it. Without this vector, normalisation could be made to satisfy the two detection vectors by flagging any long full-width digit run, which would redact routine text in exactly the locales the fix serves.
